name: Sensors & Navigation

fixtures.name: Acceleration couch
fixtures.blurb: Two of them, facing the consoles. Occupied for burns and for nothing else — the rest of the watch is spent standing at the boards.

blurb: Helm, comms, and the sensor mast. Two acceleration couches, one of them usually occupied.

name: Crew Quarters

fixtures.name: Bunk
fixtures.blurb: Six for a crew of four: the watch bill means two are always warm, and the spares are where you put a passenger or an argument.

fixtures.name: Mess table
fixtures.blurb: The only surface aboard big enough for four people at once. Meals, briefings, cards, and the occasional autopsy of a work order.

blurb: Six bunks, a galley, and the only table on the ship.

name: Life Support
blurb: Scrubbers, recyclers, and a hydroponics rack that smells faintly of wet soil.

name: Cargo Hold

fixtures.name: Cargo bay
fixtures.blurb: Empty tie-down grid. What sits here is mass, and mass is delta-v you pay for on every burn.

blurb: Four modular bays. Empty, which is the problem.

name: Machinery

fixtures.name: Spares locker
fixtures.blurb: Bar stock, seals, filter cartridges and fasteners. A repair that cannot find what it needs waits until the locker is restocked.

blurb: Workshop, spares lockers, battery bank, and the thermal loop pumps.

name: Reactor
blurb: Shielded fission plant. The shadow shield is why the tanks sit where they do.

name: Engines
blurb: Nuclear thermal cluster, cold. Preheating takes hours and a great deal of power.
